_metadata.purpose: pilot (x03): for each hint, the routes that made its approved pairs good. A route is one meaning of the hint plus the bank words that reach it (from a group in groups.json, or listed here). A candidate pair takes one word from each of two DIFFERENT routes (the double meaning or two-sided picture that made the original work); a route marked sameRoute may also pair with itself (one shared work, e.g. Disney's Frozen: MOVIE + SNOWMAN).
_metadata.clauses: clause.<WORD> is the hint-specific half-sentence for that word (sentence case inside a sentence); without it the group's reason is used. The drafted explanation is '<clause 1>, and <clause 2>.' Reviewers may fix the wording.
_metadata.seeds: approved pairs the routes were built from; the finder must regenerate them (a recall check)
_metadata.indexReview: data/unlimited/related/index-review.json (x03-index-reviewer, claude-opus-5-5): suggestions applied selectively; members added from it carry addedBy
